cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Model calls are paused since 2026-09-28.
The daily job makes no model call, so it runs unchanged.
Weekly plan: retry:paused, no items, no charge, no notice.
Routines: retry:paused every day, nothing produced.
Added-brand setup answers 503 before charging: no new hold.

cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Cron bearer checked with sameSecret: 401 otherwise.
No brand file: after renewal, sweeps and purge, only the nudge.
Nudge or lifecycle mail refused: logged, tried again next run.
Ad token refused (401/403): flagged for reconnect.
Added brand: weekly plan off until the owner switches it on.
Agent at its monthly cap: refused, nothing charged.
Cron runs at the cap end as agent_cap, with no message.
Weekly plan auto-approves only if the brand gate passes.

cards.title: Who sees what
items: The bell belongs to the account: members see the owner's.
Only the owner address gets the brief email.
Email preferences card: owner only, hidden for others.
Lifecycle emails ignore the email preference.
Reminder emails follow it: 'None' sends only the bell item.
Members see the shared account credits.
Today card approve button: owner or admin only.
